content: The use of fixed-sized vector embeddings (Doc2Vec) instead of standard bag of words (BoW) is an integral part of our pipeline. Doc2Vec produces lower dimensional vector representations (as compared to BoW) with higher semantic and syntactic content. It has been reported that Doc2Vec outperforms BoW representations in practical benchmarks of semantic similarity, as well as being less sensitive to hyper-parameters BIBREF22 .
